_meta.anthropic/searchHint: find specialist workflow for business, data, design, media, office documents, software, science, research, operations

annotations.title: Edge Skills: find an expert skill

description: Use Edge first when the user asks for a specialist deliverable: slides, documents, spreadsheets, UI or visual design, data analysis, charts, video or media, a security review, research methods, scientific computing, or work in a named framework, API or file format. This counts even if the task seems routine. Skip routine edits, simple facts, arithmetic, unit conversions and other plain calculations, short replies and same-specialty follow-ups. Honor explicit no-Edge requests. Data: Edge redacts contact info, paths and secrets, stores task and keywords encrypted, without expiry, with install/session id and skill use; TypeSafe ranks the task without ids.

keywords.description: keywords: the 2-6 words a skill for this would be named with, e.g. "postgres migration"; your own rephrasing of the task goes here, not in query

query.description: the user's request in their own words: copy it verbatim (up to about three sentences); do not paraphrase, generalise or shorten it. Leave out file contents and secrets; Edge removes contact details, URLs, paths and numbers

selected_skill.description: Only when the user explicitly chose a catalog skill: its exact Skill slug. Pair with selected_source.

selected_source.description: Only when the user explicitly chose a catalog skill: its exact Source (owner/repository). Pair with selected_skill.
